analysis:
FactChecker verified Modi's pre-2014 institution counts against Lok Sabha replies: 16 IITs (now 23 including ISM Dhanbad's upgrade), 9 IIITs (25 now) and 13 IIMs (20 now).

The same speech said more than double 15 AIIMS had been established since 2014; FactChecker found 15 sanctioned but only seven functional as of October 2020, with six of those sanctioned earlier, and rated that part partly true. It also noted seven IIMs were added under the previous government in 2007-11.

This entry covers only the IIT/IIIT/IIM counts.
notes: Verdict is scoped to the three counts the fact-checker rated true; the AIIMS claim is a separate, partly-true statement in the same speech. Quote is paraphrased/excerpted via FactChecker.
